title: Bloodlit
description:
Be sure to join our official Discord for the latest updates! Feel free to engage with the development by providing your feedback and following plans for the future of the game!

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Bloodlit is a hardcore first-person shooter designed to unite slow-paced oppressive survival horror tension with fast-paced reflex-driven close-quarters combat, with a strong emphasis on skill expression.

Survival in this game hinges on players' quick thinking and execution. You will be overwhelmed. Deny the disadvantage.

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Combat in Bloodlit is up close and technical, with limited resources to work with. It takes more than just "shooting anything that moves" to even have a chance.

Attacks can be countered with precise timing and enemies have weaknesses that can be exploited. Following up your defenses with offenses can often mean the difference between life and death.

Being outnumbered and surrounded is well expected. Players must rely on sharp reflexes and quick judgment to turn the tide, especially when enemies get closer than comfortable.

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Every enemy type in this game is carefully designed to fulfill a specific purpose and present a unique threat.

Players will be kept on their toes as they adapt to multiple types of enemy behaviors in the middle of the fray.

Whether it's to keep a mental note of a stalking figure in the distance while being outnumbered up close, or to counter every attack of the towering terror in front of you while dodging flanking threats, your ability to handle pressure from multiple angles will be the key to your survival.

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Every weapon in Bloodlit is crafted with a clear purpose. Whether it’s raw close-range firepower, precise long-range control, or tools designed to break enemy defenses and set up for melee finishers, each one offers a unique tactical edge.

Choose the tools that suit your instincts, learn their strengths, and push them to their limits. 

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

This nightmare doesn't have to be faced alone. Squad up with your friends and shed blood as a team.

⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘⫘

Yet no matter how skilled you become, escape is an illusion. You are trapped in a cycle of endless violence and suffering — a nightmare you cannot wake from. Because here, in this place drenched in blood, you are not the victim.

You are the architect of your own suffering.
description_short: Bloodlit is a hardcore first-person shooter designed to unite slow-paced oppressive survival horror tension with fast-paced reflex-driven close-quarters combat. Carve your path through the blood and ruin. Regret is for the dead.
